title: List page's three blocks each have a different heading style, and the count sits away from the members
what_happens: The add card has no heading, 'Members' is a heading outside its box, and 'List settings' is a heading inside its card. The '2 numbers' count is a third grey line in the page header, not next to Members. The page header also calls them 'numbers' while the section says 'Members'.
who_hurts: Admins reading the page: it is harder to see what the parts are and how they relate.
suggested_fix: Give each block the same heading treatment (e.g. heading above the box, like Members) and show the count on the Members heading: 'Members (2)'. Pick one word, 'members' or 'numbers'. src/app/admin/lists/[id]/page.tsx.
rule: established pattern: /admin/sessions uses one heading style ('Archived (n)') above each group
